Start Your Day with a Plan
Regain control, clarity and focus with Trevor AI - the one AI planner for all your tasks and calendars.
MEET TREVOR AI
Available on Web for mobile and desktop.
"Really loving Trevor. It's a daily habit for me now and my mind clutter had reduced significantly."
— Denis Cutura, Managing Director at Decocorp
"I wanted to reach out and just comment on how much I LOVE your "software." I have been looking for something that does exactly what yours done and it works amazingly. I love that I can create tasks and then either have "smart scheduling' or I can schedule them myself."
— Kristina Whitteker
“This app is great for helping me with prioritizing my day and scheduling my most important tasks on my calendar, so that I make sure they get done.” — Anthony Gauna
#1 See & Manage Everything
Worth Your Time
Connect multiple task lists & calendars
Schedule tasks with real-time sync
Plan with intuitive "drag & drop" and AI
“In a world of complexity and overload, the path to peace of mind is through simplification and integration.”
No more hunting for scattered to-dos or forgotten appointments. Trevor brings all your tasks and calendars together—so you can finally see everything that's competing for your time at a glance. Just drop it in and drag it all around. You are always in control.
#2 Turn To-Dos into Time-Blocks—Instantly
Trevor predicts the duration of tasks
Trevor analyses your availability
Trevor suggests a time-block - just click.
“If you talk about it, it's a dream, if you envision it, it's possible, but if you schedule it, it's real.” – Tony Robbins
Trevor’s AI does what traditional to-do lists can’t: it estimates how long tasks will take, suggests when to do them, and time-blocks everything right into your calendar. While old-school lists add more work and only get 40% completion rates, Trevor’s AI scheduling helps you finish 85% of your tasks. No more unfinished to-dos or rigid calendars—your Trevor is here to help.
#3 Plan Your Optimal Day or Week—Automatically
Trevor can instantly plan your day or week
Trevor adapts to you, continuously
Trevor uses the most advanced AI models
“The most fundamental principle of the organized mind... is to shift the burden of organizing from our brains to the external world.” - Daniel J. Levitin
Use “Plan My Day” to create your optimal schedule. Your Trevor AI adapts to your with each planning session, allowing him to predict the optimal time for each of your tasks. Offload hundreds of scheduling decisions to your AI while retaining the ultimate control. Experience all of that magic, in a single button, and all across the app.
#4 Enter Flow & Do Your Best Work
Focus on one task at a time
Start with a Task Breakdown (AI)
Write notes as you progress
"The ability to focus on what is important and ignore the rest is the hallmark of the greatest achievers." - Dean Graziosi.
While time-blocking effectively anchors your attention on the one task at hand, Trevor takes things even further with Focus Mode. Eliminate distractions, multitasking and procrastination with a timer, a note field and an AI-generated task breakdown.
#5 Ask Trevor—Your Capable Planning Assistant
Add, schedule and reschedule tasks, even in bulk
Find tasks scheduled in your calendar
Ask technical and how-to questions
"Ask Trevor is the future of personal productivity and the culmination of ~10 years of our work." - George & Dmitry, co-founders of Trevor AI
A Chat with Trevor AI is much more than a "ChatGPT experience". Trevor AI is capable of executing a variety of complex scheduling tasks, while having all the necessary context - like your tasks, calendar events, scheduling preferences and the optional personal context, making him an unrivalled planning assistant.
#6 Improve Every Day with your AI Coach
Gain momentum with daily progress insights
Review overdue and recurring tasks
Get AI Coaching on your recent schedule
"The key is in not spending time, but in investing it." - Stephen R. Covey
Wake up to a daily progress review, personalized insights, and AI-powered coaching. Trevor doesn’t just help you plan—he helps you get better at planning with every "Start My Day" email.
Trevor AI has a lot more to offer, like Scheduling Blocks, Rescheduling Suggestions, Smart Scheduling Queue, and more... make the most of your day by signing up now.

Frequently Asked Questions
What are Trevor AI's capabilities?
Trevor AI is an all-in-one AI planner for your tasks and calendars. Explore all of Trevor AI's capabilities and limitations in our
documentation
.
Is Trevor AI a Calendar or a To-do List?
Trevor AI is a smart planner that integrates both to-do lists and calendars, giving you the best of both worlds. What makes Trevor AI better than either one is the connection it facilitates between tasks and calendar events, as well as all the AI planning features.
How does Trevor AI plan my daily tasks?
Trevor AI offers an intuitive visual planner for your tasks, meetings and events. You can plan your day with AI in 1 click, you can drag & drop your tasks yourself, or you can simply ask Trevor to do it in the chat. Plan your day, your way.
Is Trevor AI Free?
Yes, a lot of Trevor AI’s features are free for personal use, including some AI planning features. Pro and Executive plans are available for those looking for an extra edge (that pays for itself many times over).
What does the “AI” in Trevor AI do?
Trevor's AI helps with organizing, planning your tasks tasks—From predicting a task's duration, category and even priority, to suggesting it’s optimal time-slot in your busy schedule, to finally breaking it down for you into 5 manageable steps - Trevor AI is with you all the way.
How does Trevor AI compare to Reclaim?
Compared to Trevor AI, Reclaim seems to have an algorithm that uses strict rules for each task. It works great for habits, but if you have over 25 tasks in your list, it can quickly become overwhelming to set rules for each one. While Trevor’s one-click AI scheduling feature is a direct competitor, you can just as easily drag & drop tasks between your task list and your calendar as much as you want, giving you effortless control over your schedule.
How does Trevor AI compare to Motion?
Compared to Trevor AI, Motion seems to be focused on executives and managers willing to pay a premium for advanced project management features. Trevor AI is the assistant for the everyday hero - by eliminating complexity and offsetting it with powerful AI automations, Trevor makes planning your day truly effortless.
How does Trevor AI compare to AkiFlow?
Compared to Trevor AI, AkiFlow’s main advantage seems to be the number of task integrations you can sync with. Trevor AI focuses on quality over quantity of integrations and provider powerful AI planning features on top of that solid foundation.
How does Trevor AI compare to Google Calendar or Microsoft Calendar?
Trevor AI doesn’t compare with popular calendar platforms, it integrates with them in real-time. You schedule a task - It pops up in Google Calendar. You move it in Google Calendar, it updates in Trevor.
Which tools does Trevor AI Integrate with?
Trevor AI integrates with both task managers and calendar platforms like: Google Calendar, Microsoft Calendar (Outlook & Office365), Apple Calendar, Google Tasks, Microsoft To-Do, and Todoist. For a complete integrations list visit our Integrations page.
